moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio jitter, written here): Two rows of 7 squares rise 40 px on a spring (k 220, c 20), 70 ms apart: the top row evenly; the bottom row adds a seeded per-item delay (±45 ms) and size (±4 %) (site seed 7). Recipe: base stagger 60 ms + ±16–33 ms and ±3 % scale per element. Site exit: fade 300 ms. Params: stagger (60 ms) · time_jitter (±16–33 ms) · size_jitter (±3 %) · seed.
